# INTERIOR DECOR DIMAPUR

INTERIOR DECOR DIMAPUR is a full-service interior design, ceiling, wall panel, and architectural finishing company based in Dimapur, Nagaland. We specialize in designing, supplying, and installing modern interior solutions for residential, commercial, retail, office, hospitality, and institutional projects across Nagaland and near by location in Assam.

## Core Services

* Interior Design & Space Planning
* Residential Interior Design
* Commercial Interior Design
* Office Interior Fit-Out
* Modular Kitchen Design & Installation
* Customized Furniture Solutions
* False Ceiling Installation
* Gypsum Board Ceilings
* PVC Ceiling & Wall Panels
* WPC Wall Panels
* POP Ceiling & Decorative Designs
* Aluminium Railings
* Aluminium Windows
* Steel Railings
* 2x2 Ceiling Boards (Grid Ceiling Systems)
* Louvers & Decorative Ceiling Systems
* Interior Renovation & Remodeling
* Turnkey Interior Execution

## Industries Served

* Residential Homes
* Apartments & Villas
* Offices & Corporate Spaces
* Retail Shops & Showrooms
